note: Synthetic template: conditioning is DISABLED so the DEM is sampled verbatim and the pipeline output stays byte-identical to a run without this file (G30/G32/G36/G37 fixtures). tests/golden/preproc_terrain_condition_case/cases/terrain_condition_policy_fill.json is the enabled variant (stream burn + Priority-Flood fill) used by G38.

authorization.note: Any DEM modification (reprojection, stream enforcement, depression filling) is a repair and needs the data owner's written authorization before `enabled` may be set to true.

production_requirement: Set enabled=true only with a filled authorization block; enable exactly the operations the data owner approved; keep algorithm_version pinned so a changed fill algorithm surfaces as a policy change, never silently.
